title: Source order tuning review
summary: This iteration creates a user-reviewable fixed source order tuning proposal. It adds a validator-backed review document with unmapped source counts, promotion candidates, suggested sections and ranks, and collection-only guidance without changing the executable source display order.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source display contract governance|source insertion handbook|source order tuning review|source inventory order reference" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: A user-tuned fixed source order needs a review surface before executable rank changes.
lessons.evidence: `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md` lists current unmapped counts, promotion candidates, suggested section/rank placements, and collection-only classes while leaving `config/source-display-contract.json` source rows unchanged.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the review file as the user-facing checklist before promoting any collection entry into a first-class logical source.

lessons.lesson: Review docs should drift-fail against the live inventory.
lessons.evidence: `npm run sources:display-contract` now validates the review path, markers, unmapped counts, candidate source ids, unmapped status, valid sections, 5-point ranks, and public-data minimization.
lessons.recommended_action: Update the review document in the same PR as future source inventory or display contract changes.

lessons.lesson: The proposal should separate promotion from collection-only support entries.
lessons.evidence: The review document distinguishes first-class logical source candidates from duplicate subchannels, mirrors, broad aggregators, investor pages, and bridge/manual entries that should remain collection-only until explicitly promoted.
lessons.recommended_action: Promote only sources with durable public identity; keep helper entrypoints under existing logical sources.

followups.action: Have the user tune `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md`, then promote approved sources into `config/source-display-contract.json` in one or more later rank-changing PRs.
